author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Global network: r20 rim holding three outlined node rings in a triangle joined by links, with spokes from two nodes out to the rim (the rim is split where a spoke joins), as in the reference. Lucide network/share construction (node rings + links).
omissions: Links are straight instead of the reference's slightly curved ones; the nodes are r3 rings (they must stay 8+ inside the rim and 9+ apart).
